title: Auditable diagnostic protocol for tiny-object label assignment
description: Read-only instrumentation of a task-aligned assigner, per-ground-truth traces of the four assignment stages (S1-S4) with identity checks, a static-proxy audit, a 2x2 weight/similarity design on AI-TODv2 with YOLO11s, and the analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper. Companion to the manuscript submitted to IEEE JSTARS.
